newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at mostly steady levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at mostly steady levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady levels on Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 110 percent, no comparison, offer 115 percent, unchanged from Monday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 100 percent, unchanged from Monday, offer 105 percent, unchanged from Monday.
- Four barges, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, one each week of September, bid 135 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points from June 2, offer 145 percent, no comparison.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of September, bid 160 percent, unchanged from Monday, no offer.
